The space
Step into our vintage Nelle Peters-designed penthouse and be transported back in time, while enjoying all the modern conveniences. This unique one-bedroom, one-bathroom space features beautiful hardwood floors, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The well-appointed living area leads to a cozy bedroom, ensuring a comfortable stay. The charming historic bathroom adds character to the space. Enjoy the convenience of an on-site coin laundry facility in the building. Unwind on the private balcony and soak in the picturesque views of the surrounding area.

Nelle Peters (1884-1974) was a trailblazing female architect who left an indelible mark on Kansas City's architectural landscape. Overcoming the challenges of a male-dominated field, she established herself as one of the most prolific architects of her time. During her remarkable career, Peters designed over a thousand buildings, including apartments, hotels, schools, and commercial spaces, with many of them listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

Her signature style often incorporated elements of Georgian Revival, Tudor Revival, and Beaux-Arts, creating a unique fusion of architectural styles that has stood the test of time. Nelle Peters' buildings are celebrated for their elegant exteriors, intricate detailing, and functional layouts that prioritize comfort and livability. By staying in this historic penthouse designed by Nelle Peters, you'll have the opportunity to experience a piece of Kansas City's architectural history and appreciate the lasting legacy of a pioneering woman in architecture.

Guests will have access to the entire penthouse during their stay. Please note that there are approximately ten steps leading from the street to the front door of the building. A newly installed elevator (2023) will swiftly take you to the top floor in seconds. For added security and convenience, both the apartment door and building door are equipped with keypads. However, between 10 pm and 8 am, guests will need to use a key fob to enter the building. Please be aware that a $100 fee will be charged by the building owner for any lost fobs.

By keeping these details in mind, I hope to ensure a pleasant and memorable stay for all my guest guests.

𖠰LARGE GROUPS/WEDDINGS-READ BEFORE BOOKING𖠰

Ev Lodge comfortably sleeps up to 21 guests across two unique spaces. If you have more than 21 guests or are planning a small wedding/event, please send us a message to see if our property will still work for your needs! 

For the best experience with 10+ adults, we strongly recommend only booking mid-March through mid-November. During winter months guests sleeping in the cabin should plan for cozy layers and may prefer to keep kids or cold sensitive guests in the main house. 

This historic cabin by the creek is a structure dating back to the 1800's where a young President Truman is said to have spent time! It has been transformed into a bunk-style retreat with 4 full-size bunk beds, creating a nostalgic summer camp feel for kids or group getaways. Equipped with an electric fireplace, electric space heater, 3 ceiling fans, AC, and walkie-talkies to stay connected with the main cabin!

Located 200 feet away is the main cabin which sleeps 13 guests and features 5 beautifully designed bedrooms, each with a king-size bed and cozy duvet bedding. Two upstairs bedrooms include twin bed sleeping nooks, perfect for little ones. A queen air mattress is stored in the upstairs hallway closet for added flexibility.

𖠰 BATHROOMS 𖠰

With 5 full bathrooms, everyone can get ready without a wait. The main floor primary suite features a clawfoot soaking tub for a touch of spa like indulgence. The second main floor bathroom includes a double vanity, dual rain shower heads, and heated floors! The basement bathroom offers a sleek rainfall shower and allows for easy access for those sleeping at "Camp Truman" by the creek. 

Each space is stocked with plush towels, toiletries, and thoughtful touches to make your stay effortless.

𖠰 KITCHEN DINING & LOUNGE 𖠰

At the heart of Ev Lodge is a renovated kitchen with stainless steel appliances. It’s perfect for everything from pancake mornings to serving up evening wine hours.

Step into your indoor dining for 18 people with a kids table located in the living room. Let in the natural air by opening the 9 foot wide bi-fold doors to access your outdoor kitchen, equipped with a natural gas grill, mini fridge and ice trough. Enjoy outdoor dining for up to 21 guests under the string lights. 

Back inside, the living room invites you to unwind on a 13.5-foot sectional and gather around the cozy electric fireplace. This room is stocked with board games & arts and crafts so your kids will feel right at home! Unwind watching your favorite show on the large Roku Smart TV equipped with Netflix during your stay. 

𖠰 OUTDOOR SPACE 𖠰

Ev Lodge’s 6-acre grounds are where the nostalgia truly happens.
Relax in the Zen garden, complete with a hot tub, 4-person sauna, cold plunge, and outdoor shower. Watch the stars from the stargazing dome, toast s’mores at the firepit lounge, or enjoy dinner under the string lights.

Adventure seekers will love the private disc golf course, tug-of-war, rock wall, soccer nets, flag football, and more! Enjoy your morning coffee in the treehouse overlooking the creek or grab your favorite book and relax on the treehouse hammock floor. The swing set and rock wall are sure to bring out everyone’s inner kid!
 
When the sun sets cue up your favorite film in the outdoor movie theater by the creek. With enough seating for 21 people, it's a perfect end to a perfect day.

Just outside of the garage is a Tesla Universal EV Charger w/ Integrated J1772 adapter to conveniently charge any electric vehicle. Whether a Tesla or non-Tesla, get up to 44 mi of range added per hour at 11.5 kW.

𖠰 INDOOR ENTERTAINMENT 𖠰

Rainy days are no problem here. Head to the game room featuring arcade games, foosball, ping pong, pool table, darts, and a KC Current soccer zone!
WiFi is lightning-fast (3 Gig Google Fiber) and the house includes a Netflix account. Board games and kids’ crafts are located in the living room to keep everyone entertained.

𖠰 Book Your Stay at The Ev Lodge & Experience Where Luxury Meets Nostalgia 𖠰

Guest access
Guests have full access to both the main lodge and the creekside cabin, as well as all indoor and outdoor amenities throughout the 6 acre property. There’s plenty of on-site parking and please no cars should drive or park on the grass. 

We provide smart lock entry and easy self check-in. Each of the bedrooms are equipped with Roku Smart TVs for your leisure with the exception of the creekside cabin. 

The property is located only 4 minutes from highway I-49 which allows for easy access to all Kansas City has to offer!

Other things to note
This is a dog-friendly home as long as your dog is 12+ months, well trained, and housebroken. By booking, you accept responsibility for any damage/extra cleaning your dog causes during the stay. No dogs left home alone unless crated. Please clean up after your pet and keep them off of the furniture. $100 per pet fee.

✅ Good News! All bookings made after February 1st, 2026 will include $1,500 in coverage for accidental damage and mishaps. We take your safety and security seriously and our property has special local compliance requirements of a signed rental agreement and ID verification. To make this easy for you, we use a secure and very simple app-free platform called Happy Guest. Upon booking, we will send you a secure link to complete the booking process. Unwind in a serene private room atop one of Kansas City's highest bluffs, in an art-filled contemporary home built just 18 months ago. Soak in sweeping views of downtown, the West Bottoms, and North KC, then relax by our private pool and hot tub under the stars. Walk to Downtown and the Crossroads Arts District, with easy access to Midtown, the interstate, and just 18 minutes to Arrowhead Stadium. The perfect home base — whether you're here for the Chiefs or simply the charm of KC.

The space
The Home:

Set in a contemporary, art-filled home built just a year and a half ago, this four-story retreat is designed for both privacy and connection. Your private guest room and bathroom are conveniently located on the ground floor near the front entrance — easy in, easy out, and quietly tucked away from the home's shared spaces above. The mostly shared floor two opens up into a bright, open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area, leading out to the pool and patio. The owners' suite occupies the private floor three, and a shared stunning rooftop deck crowns the home on floor four. Note: there's no elevator, so guests should expect stairs between floors — consider it a scenic way to earn your morning coffee!

The Backyard & Pool:

Step outside to your own private oasis — a heated/cooled pool and hot tub surrounded by a covered patio, loungers, and umbrellas for sun or shade. Whether you're soaking under the stars or sipping coffee poolside, this backyard is built for relaxing.

The Rooftop:

Climb to the top floor for sweeping 180-degree views stretching from the West Bottoms to downtown Kansas City. It's the perfect spot for a sunset cocktail or quiet morning coffee with a view.

The Location:

Nestled in the charming, bluff-top neighborhood of Westside, you're just a 5-minute walk to downtown and the Crossroads Arts District, a 5-minute drive to Westport, and a 10-minute drive to the Plaza. Catch the KC Streetcar 15 minute walk away at the Kauffman Center, or explore nearby world-class museums like the National WWI Museum, Kemper Museum of Art, and the Nelson-Atkins. With quick access to nearly every major highway, you're never more than 30 minutes from anywhere in the metro — including KCI, Overland Park, Leawood, and Lee's Summit.

Guest access
Your private room and dedicated bathroom are yours for the stay. You'll also have full access to shared spaces including the dining room, kitchen, living room, pool bath, backyard patio with pool and hot tub, and the rooftop deck — all available for you to enjoy throughout your visit.

During your stay
We're pretty chill and are open to chatting but are good to follow your lead. Just let us know how you'd prefer your stay. :)

Other things to note
We're the proud dads of two sweet cats, Alice and Cooper, who do live in the home. They're quite shy and tend to keep to themselves around guests, sticking close to their dads rather than seeking attention. If you have allergies or aren't comfortable around cats, this may not be the best fit — we want both our guests and our furry family members to feel at ease during your stay.

Explore Kansas City!
Kansas City straddes the border betwen Missouri and Kansas, split down alongside the Missouri River. This unit is in Westport, an eclectic neighborhood in Kansas City, Missouri, the city's oldest established community, originally founded in 1833. Originally a vital outfitting hub for pioneers embarking on the Santa Fe, Oregon, and California Trails, it now functions as a vibrant urban district renowned for its nightlife, dining, and historic boutiques.

Top Tourist Attractions:
Kelly's Westport Inn: Located at the corner of Pennsylvania and Westport Road, this is widely considered the oldest building still standing in Kansas City, operating today as a beloved historic Irish pub

Harris-Kearney House Museum: Built in 1855, this beautifully preserved landmark is the oldest two-story brick home in Kansas City and offers a deep dive into the lives of early pioneers

Shopping and Boutiques: The district is highly walkable and packed with independent shops like Monkey Wrench Clothing (offering pin-up and alternative fashion) and Mills Record Company for vinyl enthusiasts

Local Eats & Nightlife: Westport is legendary for its culinary and bar scene. Must-visit stops include Beer Kitchen (known for gourmet burgers and craft beer), Westport Café (French-inspired bistro), and the iconic Westport Flea Market for great food and eclectic vibes. Don't miss out on the Country Club Plaza for fine dining. The Country Club Plaza in Kansas City is a historic, Spanish-inspired district featuring over 15 blocks of dining. Top local and upscale spots include Gram & Dun for gastropub fare with a sprawling patio, The Capital Grille for dry-aged steaks, and Jack Stack Barbecue for iconic Kansas City burnt ends

Yearly attractions in the area include the St Patrick's Day Parade in March, the Summer Beer festival in June, and the  Art Westport festival in September. There is a monthly first Friday art walk downtown, parades, music and theatre shows.

A turn-of-the-century bungalow filled with historic charm. Inside you'll find curated worldly décor and multiple lounge spaces. Step into the backyard to enjoy the cedar barrel sauna, seasonal cold plunge and stock tank pool, fire pit, yard games, and the Lucky Kitty Tiki Lounge tucked away in the converted garage. Minutes from downtown, the stadiums, great restaurants, and vibrant nightlife. Primary guest must be 21+. Visitors and gatherings require advance approval.

The space
A HISTORIC BUNGALOW MADE FOR GATHERING

Built in 1900 and thoughtfully restored, Melrose Grove blends historic character, modern comfort and a playful, collected style. The home sleeps up to eight guests, with plenty of inviting spaces to gather or spread out.

The main floor includes a king bedroom, a comfortable living room with a twin daybed, a plant-filled dining room, a well-equipped kitchen, laundry facilities and has a European-style split bathroom, with the toilet and sink in one room and a separate shower immediately next door, allowing both spaces to be used at the same time.

Upstairs, one bedroom has a queen bed and a cozy reading nook with a daybed mattress. The second has a twin bed and a daybed with a pull-out twin trundle, accommodating up to three guests. The main bathroom has a tub and shower.

Outside, guests can enjoy the electric cedar barrel sauna, seasonal stock tank pool and cold plunge, fire pit, charcoal grill, hammock, outdoor seating, yard games and seasonal garden.

Tucked inside the converted garage, the Lucky Kitty Tiki Lounge is a private hangout with heating and air conditioning, a refrigerator, record player, darts and bar games.

The home also includes central heating and air conditioning, upstairs mini-splits, Smart TVs, fast Wi-Fi, books, games and plenty of thoughtful details for a memorable Kansas City stay.

Guest access
You’ll have private access to the home, front porch, front and back yards, Lucky Kitty Tiki Lounge and guest amenities throughout your stay.

AMENITY AVAILABILITY

• Cedar barrel sauna: Open year-round
• Fire pit: Available year-round, with firewood provided
• Stock tank pool and cold plunge: Typically open from mid-April through mid-October, depending on freezing temperatures and autumn leaf fall. Both are guaranteed to be open May 1 through October 1
• Lucky Kitty Tiki Lounge: Available when outdoor temperatures are between 32° and 90°F. The converted garage has heating and air conditioning but limited insulation, so it is most comfortable during milder weather

Instructions for the sauna, pool, cold plunge, fire pit and Tiki Lounge are provided in the house guidebook on the dining table.

LOCKED STORAGE AREAS

A few storage spaces are not available to guests:

• Basement storage and secondary laundry area
• Upstairs hall cleaning closet
• Storage closet in an upstairs bedroom

Other things to note
WHO WE HOST

Melrose Grove is well suited to couples, families, friends and responsible groups looking for a distinctive Kansas City stay.

The primary guest must be at least 21 and remain at the property throughout the reservation.

The reservation price covers up to eight total people at the property, in any combination of overnight guests and approved visitors. The Airbnb reservation must reflect the correct number of overnight guests, and any additional visitors must be disclosed when booking. This allows us to maintain an accurate record for safety and liability purposes and provide the appropriate supplies.

There is no event fee for up to eight total people. The maximum overnight occupancy is eight.

Kansas City–area residents and guests without prior positive Airbnb reviews require a fully refundable $150 security deposit before check-in.

GATHERINGS & EVENTS

More than eight people at the property at any time is considered an event. This total includes both overnight guests and visitors.

Events are not automatically accepted and require written approval before booking. Please share the purpose of the gathering, expected attendance and general plans. Approval is determined case by case based on the guest’s Airbnb history, the nature of the gathering and its suitability for the home and neighborhood.

If approved:

• 9–12 total people: $100 nonrefundable event fee
• 13–15 total people: $150 nonrefundable event fee
• 16 or more: Considered individually, with pricing based on the plans

Gatherings of 16 or more are generally considered for returning guests or experienced Airbnb guests with a strong history of positive stays. You’re welcome to contact us before booking to discuss your plans.

Event approval does not increase the maximum overnight occupancy of eight. All gatherings remain subject to quiet hours and neighborhood noise requirements.

Professional or commercial photography, filming and content creation are not included in these event tiers and require separate approval and pricing.

NEIGHBORHOOD

Melrose Grove is in an established, culturally diverse urban neighborhood near downtown Kansas City. We’re about a five-minute walk from Kessler Park and its trails, with easy access to the River Market, Crossroads, stadiums, restaurants and nightlife.

This is a central-city neighborhood, so expect everyday street activity and occasional city sounds. Our immediate block has felt safe and welcoming to us, and we’ve hosted more than 2,000 stays over seven years without an incident involving a guest or their property.

Comfort levels vary. Guests seeking a quiet suburban, gated or resort-style setting may be happier elsewhere, and we encourage everyone to review the general location before booking. Refunds are not provided solely because a guest feels uncomfortable with the neighborhood when no documented incident has occurred.

We welcome guests of every background and expect the same respect for our neighbors and community.

The space
Step into our vintage Nelle Peters-designed penthouse and be transported back in time, while enjoying all the modern conveniences. This unique one-bedroom, one-bathroom space features beautiful hardwood floors, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The well-appointed living area leads to a cozy bedroom, ensuring a comfortable stay. The charming historic bathroom adds character to the space. Enjoy the convenience of an on-site coin laundry facility in the building. Unwind on the private balcony and soak in the picturesque views of the surrounding area.

Nelle Peters (1884-1974) was a trailblazing female architect who left an indelible mark on Kansas City's architectural landscape. Overcoming the challenges of a male-dominated field, she established herself as one of the most prolific architects of her time. During her remarkable career, Peters designed over a thousand buildings, including apartments, hotels, schools, and commercial spaces, with many of them listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

Her signature style often incorporated elements of Georgian Revival, Tudor Revival, and Beaux-Arts, creating a unique fusion of architectural styles that has stood the test of time. Nelle Peters' buildings are celebrated for their elegant exteriors, intricate detailing, and functional layouts that prioritize comfort and livability. By staying in this historic penthouse designed by Nelle Peters, you'll have the opportunity to experience a piece of Kansas City's architectural history and appreciate the lasting legacy of a pioneering woman in architecture.

This 2+ person retreat, nestled in a vibrant/eclectic KC neighborhood, is walking distance to Westport/39th St corridor.  Expect your own private garden level entrance & off street parking; come & go as you please.  If fun, quirky & collected is your vibe, you'll appreciate the inventive ways we have found to showcase ordinary objects & repurposed cast off materials; blending the comforts of home with a touch of modern day tree-hugger styling.  Locally owned/lady operated.

The space
The private garden level entrance does involve five steps to the entrance door.  This could pose a problem for those with severe mobility issues.  Also, given the age of the building, do expect a reasonable amount of ambient noise during the day.  The space is a 600 sq ft studio apt that includes a foyer to store shoes and off load bags.  The living room sofa has a chaise on one end for relaxing/lounging/sleeping and a medium sized TV (43").  You will need to "bring" your own streaming accounts with you;  however, the system is equipped with an Amazon fire stick which includes some complimentary channels. The kitchen has all the basics for cooking.  Feel free to ask for specialty items;  likely I have what you need.  The bedroom holds one queen sized bed, long mirror, ample closet space and a bench for guest convenience.  There is laundry on site as well, in the common area of the property.

Other things to note
Our home is a beautiful 100+ year-old over-under duplex located in a historic neighborhood nestled among single family homes as well as small apartment buildings.  We ask that guests maintain a reasonable amount of noise during your stay and honor quiet hours between 10pm and 8am. This is my home and the home of long term tenants in the building.  There's plentiful opportunity to cut loose at many of the bars/restaurants/clubs within walking distance of our property.

In terms of lodging, what we ARE is an affordable alternative to hotels competitively priced with similar short term rental listings in the area.  Built into the nightly listing price is an additional 7.5% tax imposed by the City of Kansas City in August 2023.  We apologize for this unnecessary tax.  Nonetheless, we provide the creature comforts of home in a very cozy private space of 600 sq. ft.  This concept of your "home away from home" is further authenticated in this well preserved neighborhood of local residents that love their city.  If you are traveling by car, we offer access to secure off street parking free of charge.  What we are NOT is a luxury hotel.  No heated pool, no weight room, no valet parking, no desk agent at the entrance, no cookie cutter decor, etc.  Please do keep your expectations in check.  Your satisfaction depends on it :)

Located in the heart of the Crossroads Arts District, this spacious flat offers modern luxury in one of Kansas City’s most vibrant neighborhoods. Guests are treated to comfortable and well-appointed accommodations within walking distance to excellent entertainment destinations. The DayBNB has been designed to represent the lightness of daytime with light finishes throughout the space.

The space
Originally built in 1890, this building was home to the Skates Belting & Supply Company for generations. Following the retirement of the hardware shop’s proprietors, the building underwent a multi-year renovation, completed in 2022.

The renovations were designed to provide guests with a unique and comfortable experience. Distinctive touches include a two-way mirror in the master bathroom’s shower and hanging bedroom lights that simulate stars around a suspended “cloud” on the ceiling. Understanding that guests may prefer to dine in, the DayBNB features a well-stocked chef’s kitchen with seating and place settings for eight. It is equipped with a professional-style gas range with a convection oven, dishwasher, microwave, and refrigerator offering filtered water and ice.

The apartment spans approximately 1,800 square feet and includes three bedrooms, each with a queen bed. The master suite, the largest of the three, features a desk and a full bathroom with a walk-in shower. The two additional bedrooms share a hall bathroom with a tub/shower combination, dual sinks, and natural light streaming through a skylight above.

One bedroom, located in the center of the apartment, has no exterior windows. Its ceiling is open to the hallway, so noise may travel to and from the kitchen and hallway areas. This bedroom does not have a locking door and is separated from the hallway by a curtain.

This space shares the second floor with a mirror-image apartment, also accessed via a common entryway and staircase. The second apartment is available on Airbnb as NightBNB.

Guest access
Guests have dedicated access to a free parking stall located in the rear of the building. Additional free street parking is also available, in addition to paid parking lots within walking distance. There are four electric vehicle charging stalls on the street as well.

Access to the apartment is through the locked entryway located on the front of the building. Once inside there is a custom-lit staircase which leads to second floor. Here you will find the front doors of the two apartments where your personal access code will allow you inside to your private apartment.

Other things to note
For our noise sensitive guests: Southwest Blvd is a major thoroughfare of Kansas City. It’s the place to go out and be “seen” on weekend nights. There will be traffic noise during the day and most of the night. Society, a restaurant/bar located across the alley from the apartment, operates until midnight on weeknights and 1:30 AM on Friday and Saturday nights. Live and DJ’d music can be heard inside the apartment until this time coming from their outdoor patio. Every bedroom has a white noise machine for your use.

We invite you to stay at our 109 year old craftsman in the historic West Plaza district. At less than 10 minutes walking to the iconic Country Club Plaza and 18 minutes walking to Westport, you won't need a vehicle to get to some of the most trendy restaurants and shopping in the Kansas City area.

This craftsman has been beautifully decorated in a way that compliments the sophistication of the home. Contemporary materials and furniture bring fresh life into this classic American home.

The space
Size: The space is 2000 square feet with 3 bedrooms and 2.5 baths. 

Bedrooms: All three bedrooms are located upstairs (~14 stairs to reach upper floor). There is a full bathroom with a tub/shower combo to service the 2 guest bedrooms. There is a full bathroom attached to the master bedroom with a stand-up shower. All three bedrooms have memory foam mattresses. One of the beds has railing around it, perfect for toddlers/children but can be used by adults too. The railing around the bed cannot be removed.

Travel Crib Included: In the room with the bed railing, there is a travel crib stored in the closet. The travel crib is a 2021 Nuna Aire with dimensions of L 40 x W 24.5 x H 30 in. The crib is convertible into both a bassinet mode or playard mode. Crib sheet not included. 

Kitchen: Kitchen appliances include a refrigerator, oven, microwave and dishwasher. For coffee, a Keurig with pods is included for free. Most basic cooking utensils are also included, as well as non-stick Granitestone pots and pans. There is a 1/2 bathroom located on the main floor between the kitchen and living room.

Workspace: Equipped with 5G home internet and a dedicated workspace in the master bedroom.

Parking: The driveway can accommodate multiple vehicles, but large vehicles can be difficult to turn around at the bottom of the driveway. If you have a large truck/SUV, it is recommended to park along the house rather than driving to the bottom of the driveway. Street parking is also available for free. There are a couple of steps up to the front door from the street level.

Garage: There is a two car garage. The north garage is too small to fit most cars (even small ones) but the south garage can be used by guests with smaller vehicles. There is no clicker/keycode to open/close the garage from outside, so you will need to open/close from inside the garage to use it. To access the garage/basement from inside the home, there are roughly 14 stairs down to the lower level just off the kitchen. 

Electric Vehicles: The garage is equipped with a 240V Nema 14-50 plug to recharge electric vehicles. Charging equipment not included. 

Outdoor space: The house has both a front and back patio.

Washer/Dryer: Guests can use washer and dryer.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire house with the exception of the owner's closet in the master bedroom which is used to hold supplies and personal items. 

Guests have access to the garage but it will need to be opened/closed from inside the home since there isn't a clicker.

Other things to note
We kindly ask that you have prior positive review history before booking the home. 

We are unable to accept booking requests and stays from local guests who are currently based in the Kansas City Metropolitan Area.

No parties, events, or small gatherings allowed. The house has a legal occupancy max of no more than 8 people in the house at one time but please also request approval if you plan to have guests in excess of those listed on the booking. Unauthorized guests will result in a $300 fee per guest per day/night. Hosting parties/events/gatherings at the house violates the neighborhood's short term rental bylaws and we would be required to take immediate action to end the event and booking. Only guests who are in the original booking are allowed to stay so please let us know if guest changes occur so we can update the booking.

Our neighborhood is quiet with respectful neighbors, so please help to maintain the peace. Quiet hours per city ordinance are between 10 PM and 7 AM. Per the city, noise levels measured at the property boundaries shouldn't exceed that of a causal conversion (60 dBA) day or night. 

Smoking is prohibited in all areas, indoors and outdoors, within the boundary of the property.

In an effort to maintain a secure premises, the house is equipped with a Nest doorbell camera and backyard camera. The cameras are ONLY on the exterior, and there are no cameras on the inside. 

The house is also equipped with a Minut device, which is required for our insurance policy. It measures noise pressure levels (not capable of audio recording), occupancy and monitors for cigarette smoke. If noise pressure or occupancy levels exceed reasonable limits for an extended period of time, or if cigarette smoke is detected, the system will send the primary guest an automated notification. The guest will be responsible for any fees resulting from violating city noise or occupancy ordinances during their stay.

Registration Details
NSD-STR-01888

Brookside gives you a walkable "neighborhood village" vibe away from the stadium chaos, while remaining a premier hub for game-day energy.

The space
Nestled along the tree-lined streets of historic Brookside, Mod Cottage is a character-filled 1936 home designed for modern Kansas City stays. You'll have the charm of one of KC's most beloved residential neighborhoods—with restaurants, coffee shops, parks and shopping nearby—while staying within easy reach of the city's museums, sporting events and attractions.

Inside, four comfortable bedrooms and multiple living spaces give families and groups plenty of room to settle in. Gather around the large dining table, start the morning with coffee in the butler's pantry overlooking the garden, challenge each other to foosball or a game in the second living room, or unwind outside on the patio after a day exploring KC.

The space
This pet-friendly house is ideal for vacations and/or work-related travel. With three bedrooms and adjoining full bathrooms, The Treehouse works well for up to three couples or family/friends interested in a shared space to make memories together. You'll find no shortage of lighting options, pops of color with whimsy, inspirational decor, and modern, functional furniture. There's a selection of art by local artists and artists of color throughout my home, too. 

I have personally experienced wonderful Airbnb stays, as well as one unfortunate booking. Based on my global travels, and love for The Treehouse in KCMO, careful consideration has been given towards furnishings in hopes to create a comfy, enjoyable stay for you and yours. 

Main floor living room: Enjoy a faux leather modular sectional with ottomans that seat up to six. Use the Smart TV, located above the built-in gas fireplace (non-operational), loaded with popular Apps (ready to activate with your own logins), along with a Sony sound system (that can be synced to play music, too).

Dining Room: A great gathering area, off the living room and kitchen bar, seats up to six. You'll be able to enjoy a meal while continuing to watch the game or stream your favorite show from the living room TV.  

Kitchen: Stainless steel appliances and cooking furnishings are ready for your meal prep needs, including a spacious walk-in pantry. Keurig K-Duo Single-Serve & Carafe Coffee Maker included with an assortment of pods, sugar and creamer, in addition to a variety of tea bag flavors. When it's nice out and you desire fresh air, there are two mini windows available to open on each side of the fridge. 

Bathrooms: There are three full baths attached to each of the bedrooms and a half bath off the kitchen/living room (currently not pictured). Primary bath has a stand-up shower (Please note: the whirlpool tub is not operational.) and a two-sink vanity. Each of the other two baths have a shower/tub combination. You'll find shampoo/conditioner, body wash, towels, facial tissue and makeup towels for guest use. Cottonballs and Q-tips can be found in the Primary Bath. Each full bath has a hair dryer. 

Bedrooms: There are three bedrooms with each offering their own bathroom, closet and dresser, nightstands with lamps, and outdoor balcony. The Primary has a King bed with a Slumber Cloud core mattress pad. The other two guest rooms have Queen beds with mattress toppers. Each bed has multiple pillow and blanket options in hopes to achieve your desired sleep. Each also includes a ceiling fan and conveniently located outlets to charge devices. There are luggage racks and laundry baskets, too. 

Downstairs living room: This flex space can serve "working from home" needs with a provided office hutch (and Wi-Fi provided throughout the property), including extra desk lighting. There's also a second Smart TV with sound bar to connect to, DVD player with an assortment of classics to pick from, puzzles, playing cards, toys/books for children, and board games (located up in the living room coat closet). Additionally, a second built-in gas fireplace (non-operational), wet bar and mini fridge. You'll find an exercise ball, some free weights, yoga mat, two yoga blocks and a stretch foam roller, in case you wish to squeeze in some wellness time during your stay at The Treehouse. 

Ping Pong Room: It's like a cherry on top! Game on, in case you wish to elevate the fun factor during your stay. Or chart your next adventure with the maps on the green wall. 

Balconies: There are four martini decks furnished with outdoor seating options. Weather permitting and for guest use, the deck off the main living room has a number of pillows and cushions. The deck off the downstairs living room has a string of outdoor lights that can be plugged in for extra ambience.

Guest access
Up to six guests have access to the entire, standalone property (with the exception of the garage and three storage rooms in the downstairs basement area). 

To check in, guests will be given access to an assigned code for keyless front door entry.

Other things to note
Throughout my more than seven years of living at the house, I have had an active security system through Vivint. This includes a camera doorbell monitoring system (video and voice recording) and an alarm registered with the Kansas City, Missouri Police Department, which can be set with guest/owner coordination. The Treehouse is located in an urban setting. Be aware of your surroundings and use good judgement. Keep cars locked and valuables put away. From time to time, it can be noisy in the area, due in part to the nearby major medical center. It's normal to hear police sirens, ambulances, helicopters, and kids shooting hoops in the nearby apartment complex parking lot, especially when it's nice outside. If you are not used to city sounds, please proceed cautiously in booking The Treehouse. When family and friends have stayed with me, I recommend they utilize a white noise phone app, and I offer ear plugs and eye masks. I do now have a noise machine available for use in the downstairs guest bedroom.

Private parking is available to guests with the attached driveway (up to four compact cars), as well as free street parking. Please respect that my neighbors immediately to the south require assisted parking due to a neurological disease. There are seven automated outdoor lights on the front of the house, along with a motion-detector spotlight above the garage. 

The Treehouse includes access to four balcony, martini decks. There is no backyard, but rather an easement area off the north and east sides. Please do not toss trash, pet waste or anything else into the treelined part of the property. 

Per the City of Kansas City, Missouri Short-Term Rental Permit: parties are strictly prohibited, and up to seven (7) people total on the property at any given time. If this policy is violated there will be a mandatory fine of $750 to guests.

This is a smoke-free property, including no e-cigarettes or vaping inside the home. If detected, a mandatory Guest fine will be enforced.
